title: Breakout with level editor
lastAssistantText:
Done. **Deliverable: `index.html`** — a single, self-contained, offline Breakout with level editor (859 lines, zero network/CDN deps).

## What it does
- **Editor**: draw bricks (click/drag, pick a color), erase (toggle Erase brush), colored grid.
- **Play Layout**: launch your design; score + lives + bricks-left HUD; win/lose overlays with Play Again/Restart.
- **Save/Load JSON**: save produces a `breakout-level.json` download; load parses + validates and rebuilds the grid.
- **Controls**: keyboard (← → / A D move, Space launches) AND mouse/touch (drag moves paddle, tap launches; pointer draws in editor).

## Architecture (logic vs boundary)
All collision/scoring/lives/win-lose math lives in a pure, DOM-free `__BO` IIFE (lines 161–409). Only the boundary section touches `document`/canvas/pointer/`Blob`/`URL.createObjectURL`. Static scan confirmed **no `Buffer`/`require`/`process`/`module.exports`/`global` and no browser-API leaks** in the logic block.

## Verification (both passes passed, zero runtime errors)
- `verify_logic.cjs` — round-trip serialize/validate, brick-break + score, life-loss, win/lose, paddle move.
- `verify_boundary.cjs` — editor draw/erase, rendered pixel color, save round-trip, HUD, restart, keyboard launch/move.
- Static scan clean.

## Environment-only caveats (logged separately, not app bugs)
- The VM's download listener records the anchor but not the Blob body, so saved JSON bytes couldn't be read back here — correctness proven structurally via serialize/validate + disk reparse instead. In a real browser the Blob downloads normally.
- File-input load path and live touch events couldn't be injected in the VM; load validated via `validateLevel` on valid/invalid shapes.

Details in `VERIFY.md`; `PLAN.md` has requirements/architecture/checklist. STL analyzer not applicable (no 3D export in the brief).
